function: Downlink FDD massive MIMO channel estimation from pilots, using deep-unrolled networks (coarse estimation net, fine correction net) that exploit angular-domain intra-frame and inter-frame sparsity (p. 2-7).
system: FDD downlink massive MIMO, BS with 128 antennas, UE with 2, pilot length T = 33, L = 7 frames, angular-domain sparse channel; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 3, 8).
method: Deep unrolling of BCD-MMV l2,1 minimization: coarse estimation net (8 layers) and fine correction net (16 layers) with trainable weights, thresholds; supervised MSE loss, layer-by-layer training (p. 5-8).
data_channel: Own synthetic angular-domain channels: i.i.d. complex Gaussian coefficients on random block-sparse supports as in [11]; 20000 training, 5000 validation, 1000 test samples (p. 8).
test_conditions: 20000/5000/1000 train/validation/test samples from one synthetic model; figures sweep SNR, pilot length T and shared-support count s_c; retraining per setting not stated (p. 8-10).
baselines: Non-learned: M-SP [11] and Enhanced MMV [12] compressive-sensing algorithms. Learned: LISTA-CPSS [24] and LISTA-GS [25] deep-unrolled networks (p. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (dB) of the estimated channel versus SNR, pilot length and shared-support count (p. 8-10).
complexity: Multiplications per iteration per frame: 8NMT + 4NM (coarse net) and 8NMT + 4NM + 4M (fine net), Table III; running time in Fig. 10 (p. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 8: "channel coefficients in G are i.i.d. complex Gaussian with" zero mean and unit variance. The data are the authors' own synthetic block-sparse angular-domain model; no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO channel and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "validation and test dataset is K = 20000, K = 5000 and" 1000. Test samples come from the same synthetic model, and the sweeps over SNR, pilot length T and s_c do not state any model trained under other settings.
q3_support: p. 10: "LISTA-CPSS [24]" and LISTA-GS [25] are earlier deep-unrolled networks, "M-SP [11]" and Enhanced MMV [12] are classical compressive sensing; p. 9: "proposed C-F-BSS and C-F-BFSJ outperform all the baseline" schemes in NMSE (Fig. 7).
q4_support: p. 10: "TABLE III: Number of multiplications in each iteration to" estimate the channel matrix in one frame, for example 8NMT + 4NM for the coarse net; p. 11 reports running times (Fig. 10).
q5_support: p. 12: "for providing his code" thanks another author for baseline code. The authors give no link or DOI to their own code or data, and the channels are synthetic.
notes: Graded on the arXiv v1 of Oct 2022; the published 2024 version may add experiments. Area 2 because the deep-unrolled networks estimate the downlink channel. q2 is 0 because the paper never states that a model trained under one setting was tested under another; pilot length T changes the measurement matrix size, so retraining there is likely but not stated. Learned baselines for q3 are LISTA-CPSS [24] and LISTA-GS [25].
